fieldData.acrm---integration-feature-4:
Of 36 scanned sheets, 4 go to a person to check

Ferro Valley Water District has 36 paper sign in sheets from last year's safety committee meetings. Each scan is read into the same fields as the phone form. On 4 sheets a name is read at low confidence, and safety coordinator Gideon Marsh checks those before they are saved.
fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { toolboxTalks: "I run a toolbox talk for my construction crew every Monday. Build a safety sign in sheet where I fill in the topic, the date, and my name as the trainer once, and each crew member signs in on a phone with a printed name and an e-signature.", missedSessions: "Our warehouse holds a quarterly forklift refresher meeting for 25 operators. Build a sign in sheet that checks who signed against the roster and emails anyone who missed it with the date of the makeup session. Mark them as missed until they sign in at the makeup.", fireDrills: "We run fire drills at a medical office building with 3 floors. Build a sign in sheet staff open on their phones at the assembly point, and show the fire warden a live count by floor of who has signed in and who is still missing.", paperSheets: "Our safety committee kept a year of paper sign in sheets. Read each scanned sheet into the same fields as our new phone sign in sheet: the meeting, the topic, and each member's name. Send any name you are unsure of to our safety coordinator to check before it is saved." };

fieldData.description: Build a wedding RSVP site that finds each guest's invitation and takes meal choices, with every reply in a database you own.
fieldData.acrm---key-feature-sub-heading: Describe how your invitations work. Emergent builds the site guests reply on, the rules behind it, and the guest list it fills.
fieldData.acrm---key-feature-5-content:
The site at a domain you choose

Publish the RSVP page at your own wedding domain instead of a platform address. Custom domains are included with Emergent and use credits. Guests type the address on the card.
fieldData.acrm---key-feature-6-content:
The code, in your own GitHub repository

Export the full RSVP site to your GitHub repository on paid plans. The guest list and every saved reply move with it, and a friend who writes code can host it after the wedding.
fieldData.awb---integration-feature-1:
The caterer gets 142 plates counted by guest name

Every attending guest picks an entree under their own name, with a box for allergies. When replies close 3 weeks before the wedding, Larkspur Catering gets the count: 61 short rib, 48 salmon, and 33 risotto, which makes 142 plates. The 7 allergy notes travel with it, each one beside the guest who wrote it.
fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { householdInvitations: "Build an RSVP site for our wedding. Guests type their last name and see only the people their invitation names. Each person gets an attending or declined choice. Show a field for an extra guest only on invitations where we offered a plus-one. Save every reply to our guest list with the household it belongs to.", mealCounts: "Add a meal question to our wedding RSVP. Each attending guest picks short rib, salmon, or risotto under their own name, with a box for allergies. When replies close 3 weeks before the wedding, send our caterer the count per entree and the allergy notes, each next to the guest who wrote it.", replyReminders: "Our wedding RSVP has a reply date. Ten days before it, email every household that has not answered a reminder with its own RSVP link. Three days after that, send me the households that are still silent as a call list with a phone number for each.", weddingWeekends: "Our wedding weekend has a welcome dinner, the ceremony, and a Sunday brunch. Only some guests are invited to the dinner. Show each guest only the events on their invitation, save replies per event, and give me a list of dinner guests I can send to the restaurant." };
fieldData.afb---how-to-step-5-des: Write the lookup, the plus-one rule, the meal question, and the reminder schedule into one prompt. Emergent builds the site and the guest table from it. Change anything later by asking for it in the same chat.
fieldData.afb---how-to-step-6-des: Print the site address or a QR code that opens it on the invitation, with the reply date beside it. Guests who prefer paper can still mail a card back. Enter those replies on the same list, and the headcount stays whole.
